details:
It's not a "direct" feature request now, but I would like to see more events and for the community in general. I feel like there is more for "creators" but not for "just" players, maybe with the addition of giving them something back.

And also such events like minigames that take place regularly, for example if an event takes place 7 days and someone has the most points in a minigame, wins 1 month VRC Plus or something. 

So events that you then link to game worlds. 

Or just that you take screenshots of "only allowed worlds", upload them somewhere, for example Discord and the one with the most likes of the players wins and/or may only a certain avatar (For example, as an screenshot idea only standard quest avatars allowed :D) or also for VR people you have to make a certain pose and photograph yourself on the world doing so.

Simply to promote more activity of the community, I also have the feeling that it is boring for those who can not build their own worlds and avatars and I find it more than difficult to make their own worlds and avatars, so generally the basic idea "promoting the activity of the entire community".

Sorry if sentences are wrong or something, I use a translator. :/
title: More Events for the Community
